$comment: Generated by scripts/catalog/build.ts from docs/lld/*.md front matter. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:build`.

items.name: Badge
items.summary: Short status text with a status colour, e.g. an order status.

gap.reason: Gate 2 gap: no status badge (order status). Must pair colour with text, never colour alone.

items.name: Button
items.summary: Triggers an action; primary, secondary and ghost variants.

gap.reason: No button atom: the clear-filters control is a styled chip. Product UI (forms, CRUD) needs primary, secondary and ghost buttons.

items.name: Delta indicator
items.summary: Direction glyph plus signed change, coloured positive or negative.

gap.reason: Change KPIs show the sign as text only; color.data.positive/negative exist but nothing uses them.

items.name: Formatted value
items.summary: A number formatted from a format token, in tabular numerals; an em dash when missing.

items.name: Icon
items.summary: One glyph from the icon set.

gap.reason: No icon set (ADR-003 picks one). Badge, EmptyState, Button and the delta indicator need it.

items.name: Input
items.summary: Single-line text entry.

gap.reason: No text input. Field, SearchBox and every CRUD form need one.

items.name: Label
items.summary: Text that names a control.

gap.reason: Filters use fieldset legends and inline text; forms need a Label atom.

items.name: Select
items.summary: Native single-choice dropdown, styled as a pill.

items.name: Separator
items.summary: A rule between groups of content.

gap.reason: Not needed by any screen yet; part of the shadcn base set for product UI.

items.name: Skeleton
items.summary: Placeholder shape shown while data loads.

gap.reason: Loading is a 'Loading data…' line and panels pop in.

items.name: Sparkline
items.summary: A word-sized trend line with no axes.

gap.reason: The KPI card has no trend slot.

items.name: Tooltip
items.summary: Extra text shown on hover and keyboard focus.

gap.reason: Panel descriptions sit in title=, which keyboard and screen-reader users cannot reach.

items.name: Unit label
items.summary: The unit next to a value (pts, %, USD).

gap.reason: Units live in panel titles, e.g. 'Change (points)'.

items.name: Axis
items.summary: Chart axis (ticks, labels, title, grid) drawn by the chart engine from the generated theme.

items.name: Empty state
items.summary: What a panel shows with no data, or when it fails.

gap.reason: Three behaviours today: D3 'No data', KPI '—', and empty axes from Vega-Lite, Flint and Plotly. Errors use one red class for four jobs.

items.name: Field
items.summary: Label, control, help text and error message as one unit.

gap.reason: CRUD and settings forms need label + input + help + error.

items.name: Filter chip
items.summary: Toggle chip (aria-pressed) for one value of a multiselect filter.

items.name: KPI value with delta
items.summary: A current value with its change against a comparison period.

gap.reason: Period comparison: sp500-today shows change, change % and previous close as three unrelated tiles.

items.name: Legend
items.summary: Chart legend drawn by the chart engine from the generated theme.

items.name: Navigation card
items.summary: Index-page link to one dashboard, listing its validation errors.

items.name: Panel frame
items.summary: The card a panel sits in: title, body and an error boundary.

items.name: Search box
items.summary: Text input with a search icon and a clear button.

gap.reason: CRUD list pages need it; no screen does yet.

items.name: Title band
items.summary: Page heading and description.

items.name: App header
items.summary: Product name, navigation and account controls.

gap.reason: No app chrome yet; pages have only a title band. Needed once there is more than the index.

items.name: Chart panel
items.summary: A chart in a panel frame, written as Vega-Lite, Flint, a D3 chart or Plotly.

items.name: Data table
items.summary: Rows and columns with sorting, number formats and conditional formats; also the text alternative for every chart.

gap.reason: Gate 2 gap (no table or matrix), and the data-table fallback every chart needs for accessibility. Needs a `table` renderer.

items.name: Filter bar
items.summary: The dashboard filters: chip groups and selects.

items.name: KPI card
items.summary: One headline number in a panel.

items.name: Ranked bars
items.summary: Top-N horizontal bars with direct value labels; a D3 chart used inside a chart panel.

items.name: Sidebar
items.summary: Section navigation for multi-page apps.

gap.reason: Needed by report templates and CRUD apps; nothing uses it yet.

items.name: CRUD list template
items.summary: A searchable, sortable list of records with create and row actions.

gap.reason: Product UI side of the system; no CRUD page exists yet (Definition of done asks for one).

items.name: Dashboard template
items.summary: Title band, filter bar, then 12-column rows of panels: KPI band, primary chart, supporting charts.

items.name: Detail template
items.summary: One record: header, fields and related lists.

gap.reason: Product UI; also the shape of a BI drill-through page.

items.name: Settings template
items.summary: Grouped forms with save and cancel.

gap.reason: Product UI; no settings page exists yet.
